question: What is the Support SLA Policy?
short_answer: Sev-1 (system down) tickets: first response within 30 minutes, resolution target 4 hours.
detailed_answer: Sev-1 (system down) tickets: first response within 30 minutes, resolution target 4 hours. Sev-2 (major impact): first response within 2 hours, resolution target 1 business day. Sev-3/4 (minor/general): first response within 1 business day, resolution target 3 business days. Enterprise-tier customers receive a dedicated escalation path with faster SLAs per their contract.
escalation_path: Support Associate -> Support Team Lead -> Support Manager -> Customer Experience Director

question: Can an employee from a different department ask a Customer Support / Helpdesk question?
short_answer: Yes. Customer Support / Helpdesk knowledge is retrievable company-wide; only documents marked restricted or management-level require extra authorization.
detailed_answer: MK-Infinite-AI's knowledge base does not gate department knowledge behind the requester's own department. An employee from any department can ask a Customer Support / Helpdesk question (for example, an IT employee asking about the leave policy). Access is instead controlled per-document via the 'access_level' and 'allowed_departments' metadata, so general employee-facing knowledge remains available company-wide while restricted or management-level documents stay protected.
